Implement the following plan:

# Plan: Add Spot, Hyperliquid & Coinbase Download Configs

## Context
The RAID already has binance-futures data (~5.7 TB across 7 data types). The user wants:
1. **Binance spot** – mirror the same symbols as the 3 existing futures profiles
2. **Hyperliquid** – perpetuals (data available from 2024-10-29 on Tardis)
3. **Coinbase** – spot (data available from 2019-03-30 on Tardis)

Two new YAML config files will be created alongside the existing `configs/ml_quant_download.yaml`.

---

## Files to Create

### 1. `configs/spot_download.yaml`
Four profiles (lean data types: `trades`, `book_snapshot_25`; no derivative_ticker/liquidations since spot):

| Profile | Exchange | Symbols | Start date | Est. size |
|---------|----------|---------|-----------|-----------|
| `binance_spot_btc` | binance | BTCUSDT | 2019-03-01 | ~25 GB |
| `binance_spot_eth_sol` | binance | ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT | 2019-09-01 | ~40 GB |
| `binance_spot_altcoins` | binance | 150 altcoins (same as futures) | 2022-01-01 | ~2–3 TB |
| `coinbase_main` | coinbase | 20 major pairs (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, etc.) | 2019-03-30 | ~50 GB |

**Coinbase symbols** use dash-separated format (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, etc.). Selected pairs: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, AVAX-USD, LINK-USD, DOT-USD, ADA-USD, MATIC-USD, DOGE-USD, XRP-USD, LTC-USD, UNI-USD, AAVE-USD, ATOM-USD, NEAR-USD, FIL-USD, COMP-USD, MKR-USD, SNX-USD, CRV-USD.

**Binance spot symbols** use same format as futures (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, etc.).

**Data types for spot profiles**: `trades`, `book_snapshot_25`
(derivative_ticker and liquidations are futures-only; quotes and book_snapshot_5 excluded to limit storage)

Storage settings point to `/mnt/raid/crypto` same as existing config.

---

### 2. `configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml`
Two profiles:

| Profile | Symbols | Data types | Start date | Est. size |
|---------|---------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| `hyperliquid_major` | BTC, ETH, SOL | trades, book_snapshot_25, derivative_ticker | 2024-10-29 | ~15 GB |
| `hyperliquid_altcoins` | 20 alts (ARB, AVAX, BNB, DOGE, LINK, MATIC, NEAR, APT, OP, INJ, SEI, TIA, WIF, PEPE, BONK, SUI, TON, ATOM, FIL, HBAR) | trades, book_snapshot_25, derivative_ticker | 2024-10-29 | ~50 GB |

**Hyperliquid symbols** use base asset only (BTC, ETH, SOL — no quote suffix).

**Data types**: `trades`, `book_snapshot_25`, `derivative_ticker`

---

## Key Config Settings (both files)
- `storage.root_dir: /mnt/raid/crypto`
- `storage.format: csv`
- `download.concurrency: 10`
- `download.skip_existing: true`
- `download.retry_attempts: 5`
- `download.timeout_seconds: 600`
- `incremental.enabled: true`
- `index.enabled: true`, `index.existing_check: index`
- State/index/db files: `/mnt/raid/crypto/.tardis_spot_state.json`, `.tardis_hl_state.json` etc. (separate from futures state to avoid conflicts)

---

## Usage After Implementation
```bash
# Dry run to verify
td-fire config-download --config configs/spot_download.yaml --profile binance_spot_btc --dry-run
td-fire config-download --config configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml --profile hyperliquid_major --dry-run

# Download
td-fire config-download --config configs/spot_download.yaml --profile binance_spot_btc
td-fire config-download --config configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml --profile hyperliquid_major

# Incremental sync
td-fire incremental --config configs/spot_download.yaml --profile binance_spot_btc
```

---

## Storage Warning
- `binance_spot_altcoins` with 150 symbols × trades + book_snapshot_25 from 2022 ≈ **2–3 TB**
- The RAID has 82 TB free so storage is not a concern, but download time will be significant

# Hyperliquid Download Configuration
# =====================================
# Hyperliquid perpetuals data for ML/quant research.
# Data available from 2024-10-29 on Tardis.
# Total estimated size: ~65 GB
#
# Note: Hyperliquid uses base asset only as symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL — no quote suffix)
#
# Usage:
#   td-fire config-download --config configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml --profile hyperliquid_major --dry-run
#   td-fire config-download --config configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml --profile hyperliquid_major
#   td-fire incremental --config configs/hyperliquid_download.yaml --profile hyperliquid_major

version: "1.0"

# Storage settings - RAID storage
storage:
  root_dir: "/mnt/raid/crypto"
  format: "csv"

# ============================================================================
# DOWNLOAD PROFILES
# ============================================================================

profiles:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Profile 1: hyperliquid_major - BTC, ETH, SOL perpetuals
  # Estimated size: ~15 GB
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  hyperliquid_major:
    description: "Hyperliquid BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals - trades, book snapshots, derivative ticker"
    exchanges:
      - hyperliquid
    data_types:
      - trades
      - book_snapshot_25
      - derivative_ticker
    symbols:
      hyperliquid:
        - BTC
        - ETH
        - SOL
    date_range:
      start: "2024-10-29"  # Earliest available for Hyperliquid on Tardis
      end: null  # Today
